MEET YOUR INJECTOR At Lush we focus on patient experience, safety, and refreshed outcomes. Hello! I’m Christina, Nurse Practitioner injector. I have been a nurse for 20 years. Opening Lush Aesthetics has been my lifelong dream. As a child when someone would ask me what I wanted to be when I grow up I would always tell people I wanted to work part-time as a hairdresser and a nurse. Here I am blending art and beauty with nursing, this is my dream! OUR MISSION IS SIMPLE… Your safety & outcomes are always my top priority! Many clients come in with concerns of looking overdone or not like themselves. After a review of treatments & options as well as seeing some before & afters of other clients, those fears melt away & they are so happy they came in to start their medical aesthetics journey. Ready for that natural refreshed lush look?
